budget_items.topic: Flat Hill Road culvert reconstruction cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The engineer reported a 2019 similar culvert project cost $550k and current similar projects are around $850k; the town plans to secure Small Bridge Grant funding.
budget_items.quote: our engineer did a similar culvert project in 2019 that cost $550k and today's similar projects are around $850k.

budget_items.topic: Flat Hill Road culvert funding source
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The plan is to secure funding through the Small Bridge Grant program; no grant amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: secure funding through the small bridge grant program and put it out to bid for a construction season

budget_items.topic: ARPA / CLFRF county reallocation to Lunenburg
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lunenburg's County Reallocation is printed as $2,279,580, with 50% ($1,139,790) expected on or about August 16th in two tranches.
budget_items.quote: lunenburg's county reallocation is $2,279,580. we will beeligible to receive 50% of this allocation ($1,139,790) on or about august 16th.

budget_items.topic: Lions Club food pantry relocation operating costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Relocating the food pantry to the TC Passios raises additional operating costs, which were discussed without a figure.
